trap.label: keep (sentidos)
trap.wrong: Keep to try. Keep the receipt and keep calmly. Please keep your promise to me.
trap.right: Keep trying. Keep the receipt and keep calm. Please keep your promise.
trap.why: Em português “continue tentando” e “mantenha a calma” usam estruturas variadas. Em inglês, keep + -ing (continuar), keep + adjetivo (estado, não advérbio) e keep a promise (cumprir).

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com keep: “She continues to sing.”
Reescreva no passado: “I keep the ticket.”
